items.name: theme
items.title: uiness theme
items.description: Neutral theme with the same variable names as shadcn/ui, so both registries mix freely. Adds chart colors, a layer scale, motion durations and easings, and a type scale.

theme.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
theme.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

items.name: utils
items.title: cn()
items.description: Class name helper built on clsx and tailwind-merge.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with variants, sizes, a loading state and asChild.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An accessible loading indicator in the current text color.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A dialog that asks for a decision, plus a confirm() you can await from anywhere.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right click menus declared once for the whole app by name, picked per element with a hook, extended or replaced where needed.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: Guided tours declared once by name and started from anywhere: a spotlight around each target and a card that walks through the steps.

items.name: island
items.title: Island
items.description: Dynamic Island wired to the theme tokens. Installs @uiness/island.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: Image with loading transitions and theme defaults. Installs @uiness/image.

items.name: fx
items.title: Fx
items.description: Canvas image effects with theme defaults. Installs @uiness/fx.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline callout with info, success, warning and destructive variants, each with its icon.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A bordered table that scrolls sideways, with selected rows and an optional sticky header.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Shows and hides a section. Closed content stays in the page, findable with Ctrl+F.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that open in place. Closed answers stay in the page for search engines and Ctrl+F.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The shadcn/ui chart API on recharts: ChartContainer with a config of labels and colors, tooltip and legend contents in the theme. Installs over an existing shadcn chart.tsx.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: Grouped or stacked bars from a list of series, with dates, tooltip, legend toggles and an empty state. Built on recharts through chart.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: Straight or smooth lines from a list of series, with area fill, gaps for missing values, tooltip, legend toggles and an empty state. Built on recharts through chart.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toaster wired to the theme tokens. Installs @uiness/toast.

items.name: choreo
items.title: Choreo
items.description: Animates a whole site from what is already on the page, skipping the components here that animate themselves. Installs @uiness/choreo.

items.name: gallery
items.title: Gallery
items.description: Image grid with a full screen lightbox that flies from the thumbnail.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scrollable region with thin themed bars.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pick one option from a list.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Panel from any edge with drag to close, snap points and a check before it closes. Bottom sheet by default.

items.name: navbar
items.title: Navbar
items.description: Site navigation that collapses into a menu or a bottom bar on small screens.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette and searchable lists, with a dialog and a keyboard shortcut hook.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select, single or multiple.

items.name: use-in-view
items.title: useInView
items.description: Whether an element is on screen, with IntersectionObserver.

items.name: use-until-found
items.title: useUntilFound
items.description: Keeps a collapsed panel in the page with hidden="until-found" and opens it on a find in page match.

items.name: use-reduced-motion
items.title: useReducedMotion
items.description: Tracks the prefers-reduced-motion setting.

items.name: spotlight
items.title: Spotlight
items.description: A light that follows the pointer over a section, and a card whose border glows around it.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Slow drifting blurred blobs of color for a background.

items.name: meteors
items.title: Meteors
items.description: Streaks falling across a background.

items.name: pattern
items.title: Pattern
items.description: Grid or dot background that fades towards the edges.

items.name: sparkles
items.title: Sparkles
items.description: Twinkling particles on a canvas.

items.name: text-generate
items.title: Text Generate
items.description: Text that appears one word at a time from a blur.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types words one character at a time, deletes and moves on.

items.name: flip-words
items.title: Flip Words
items.description: One word from a list at a time, each swap blurred in.

items.name: shimmer
items.title: Shimmer
items.description: Text with a highlight sweeping across it.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: A number that counts up to its value when it scrolls into view.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Plays a transition when content scrolls into view, with stagger.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that tilts in 3D towards the pointer, with layered depth.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Content that scrolls forever, sideways or up, pausing on hover.

items.name: moving-border
items.title: Moving Border
items.description: A border with a light running around it.

items.name: animated-tooltip
items.title: Animated Tooltip
items.description: Overlapping avatars with a springy name card on hover.

items.name: hover-highlight
items.title: Hover Highlight
items.description: One highlight that slides between items as you hover them.

items.name: compare
items.title: Compare
items.description: Two layers with a divider you drag, keyboard accessible.

items.name: tracing-beam
items.title: Tracing Beam
items.description: A line beside long content that lights up as you scroll.

items.name: parallax-grid
items.title: Parallax Grid
items.description: Columns that scroll at different speeds. Installs @uiness/scroll.

items.name: sticky-scroll
items.title: Sticky Scroll
items.description: Text sections beside a sticky panel that swaps as you read. Installs @uiness/scroll.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: Entries down a line that lights up as you scroll. Installs @uiness/scroll.

items.name: path-morph
items.title: Path Morph
items.description: Morphs between any SVG paths.

items.name: link-preview
items.title: Link Preview
items.description: A link that shows a picture of its destination on hover.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A grid of cards with spans, headers and a hover lift.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible sidebar with groups, menus, stacked views and a remembered state. Becomes a drawer on phones.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid to pick a day, several days or a range. No date library.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A button that opens a calendar, for a day or a range.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields that wire label, description and error to a control with the right ARIA. Works with any form library or none.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Pick one of several options.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number, or a range with two thumbs.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A row of toggles, one or several pressed at a time.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one time code field over a single real input, so paste and SMS autofill work.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A bounded number entry with minus and plus buttons, held to repeat, arrow and page keys, and Intl formatting for percent, currency and units.

items.name: password-field
items.title: Password Field
items.description: A password input with a reveal toggle, an optional strength meter with a built in scorer, and a checklist of rules.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: A search input with a clear button, a loading state and a shortcut that focuses it. Can start as an icon button that grows into the field.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Typed values become removable tags on Enter, a comma or a pasted list, with a limit, validation and keyboard navigation between tags.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Pick several options from a searchable list, shown as tags in the trigger with a +N overflow, select all, clear and groups.

items.name: chip-group
items.title: Chip Group
items.description: Filter chips, one or several at a time, that fill in and slide a check in when picked.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: Text that becomes a field where it stands, with no layout shift. Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels, with validation and async saves.

items.name: radio-cards
items.title: Radio Cards
items.description: Selectable option cards with a selection ring that slides between them, slots for icon, title, description and price, and radio keyboard behaviour.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A time field in segments you type into or step with the arrows, with an optional list of times.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Two months side by side with a column of presets, and Apply and Cancel when you want them.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A swatch that opens a picker: area, hue and opacity, hex, rgb, hsl and oklch, eye dropper, saved colors and a contrast check.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: A phone field with a searchable country picker, formatting as you type and E.164 out.

items.name: money-input
items.title: Money Input
items.description: A currency field that groups as you type and hands back integer minor units.

items.name: mention-input
items.title: Mention Input
items.description: A textarea where @ and # open suggestions at the caret, and mentions act as single tokens.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: Ink that thins with speed, with undo, clear, replay and PNG or SVG export.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A horizontal run of items of any width and any content, snapped as you scroll.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: A list you reorder by dragging or with the keyboard. Installs @uiness/dnd.

items.name: kanban
items.title: Kanban
items.description: Columns of cards, moved inside a column or across them. Installs @uiness/dnd.

items.name: reorderable-grid
items.title: Reorderable Grid
items.description: A grid rearranged in two directions, the way app icons move. Installs @uiness/dnd.

items.name: draggable
items.title: Draggable
items.description: Anything you can pick up and move, optionally kept inside its parent. Installs @uiness/dnd.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Files dropped in from the desktop, checked by type, size and count.

items.name: gradient-text
items.title: Gradient Text
items.description: Text filled with a flowing gradient, plus a matching gradient border.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that decodes itself from random glyphs, on mount, in view or on hover.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: A number whose digits roll to their new value.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: A paragraph whose words light up as it scrolls by. Installs @uiness/scroll.

items.name: confetti
items.title: Confetti
items.description: Canvas confetti bursts from a function call or a button, with no dependencies.

items.name: orbit
items.title: Orbit
items.description: Items circling a center, spread evenly and kept upright.

items.name: sonar
items.title: Sonar
items.description: Rings pulsing out from an avatar, a status dot or a point.

items.name: retro-grid
items.title: Retro Grid
items.description: A synthwave floor grid rolling towards you, fading at the horizon.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: A feed that adds items one at a time, newest on top, with a spring.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: A pile of cards that goes round on a timer, click, swipe or arrow keys.

items.name: velocity-marquee
items.title: Velocity Marquee
items.description: Rows of text that run sideways and speed up with the scroll. Installs @uiness/scroll.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A terminal window that types commands and prints output in order.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Content that pulls towards a nearby pointer and springs back, with an inner layer for parallax.

items.name: ripple
items.title: Ripple
items.description: An ink ripple that spreads from where you press, for buttons and cards.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS style dock whose items magnify under the pointer, with labels and a hop on click.

items.name: flip-card
items.title: Flip Card
items.description: A card that turns over in 3D on hover, on click or when controlled.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A primary action joined to a chevron that opens a menu of related actions.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Related buttons joined in one surface with hairline dividers and a highlight that glides between them.

items.name: expanding-button-group
items.title: Expanding Button Group
items.description: Icon buttons where the one under the pointer or keyboard grows to reveal its label.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies a value with an icon that turns into a check, an optional tooltip and an announcement.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: A button that acts only after being held down, with a fill that sweeps across and rewinds on release.

items.name: confirm-morph
items.title: Confirm Morph
items.description: A button that asks to confirm in place, shows a spinner while the action runs and offers Undo.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A few mutually exclusive views with a thumb that slides to the chosen one.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: A light and dark switch that sweeps the new theme over the page with the View Transitions API.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key caps and shortcuts, with ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits in the hierarchy. A trail that folds its middle crumbs into a menu when there are too many or they do not fit.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links in the shadcn shape, plus a Paginator that works out the pages and ellipses and turns into "Page 2 of 10" on phones.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: Nested folders and items with the full tree keyboard, single or multiple selection, checkboxes with mixed folders and children loaded on demand.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Steps of a flow, done, current, upcoming or failed, with lines that fill as you advance. Horizontal or vertical.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card on hover or focus, with open and close delays and a springy entrance. Includes a ready-made profile card.

items.name: resizable-panels
items.title: Resizable Panels
items.description: Panels with handles between them to trade space, by pointer or keyboard. Limits, folding, double click to reset and a remembered layout, without a library.

items.name: expandable-card
items.title: Expandable Card
items.description: A card that grows out of its place in a grid into a larger view, and folds back into it when closed.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What to show when there is nothing to show: a drawing or icon, a title, a line and the next step. Four drawings in the theme's colors.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement Bar
items.description: A banner across the top that rotates messages, counts down to a date and folds away when dismissed, remembered.

items.name: swipe-actions
items.title: Swipe Actions
items.description: List rows that reveal actions when swiped, with a full swipe for the first one and the same actions in a menu.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero 01
items.description: A centered hero with an announcement pill, a headline ending in a gradient, a lead and two actions over a fading grid.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing 01
items.description: Three plan cards with a monthly/yearly switch that rolls the prices, and a flowing ring around the recommended plan.

items.name: testimonials-01
items.title: Testimonials 01
items.description: Two rows of quote cards drifting in opposite directions, with ratings and initials avatars.

items.name: faq-01
items.title: FAQ 01
items.description: A heading and contact link beside a list of questions that slide open, one column when narrow.

items.name: navbar-01
items.title: Navbar 01
items.description: A site header with a wordmark, links under a sliding highlight, sign in and a button, folding into a menu panel when narrow.

items.name: footer-01
items.title: Footer 01
items.description: A footer with brand, social links, link columns, a newsletter signup that thanks in place and a bottom bar with legal links.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: Call to Action 01
items.description: A closing call to action card with an aurora, a pointer spotlight, a pulsing badge, a headline and two actions.

items.name: auth-01
items.title: Auth 01
items.description: A sign in form with password reveal, a pending submit, provider buttons and a customer quote panel on wide containers.

items.name: hero-02
items.title: Hero 02
items.description: A split hero: headline, lead, actions and small stats beside a product shot on a tilting card, with a drawn mockup when there is no image.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Features 01
items.description: A heading over a grid of six features with icons, in one to three columns, cascading in on scroll.

items.name: features-02
items.title: Features 02
items.description: A bento of features with small live previews: a rolling counter, growing bars, drifting tags and working switches.

items.name: logos-01
items.title: Logos 01
items.description: A trusted-by line over an endless row of text and icon wordmarks that fades at the edges and pauses on hover.

items.name: stats-01
items.title: Stats 01
items.description: A heading over four big figures that count up on scroll, with labels, captions and hairline dividers.

items.name: changelog-01
items.title: Changelog 01
items.description: A release feed filtered by tag chips, grouped by month, with version badges, entries that open in place and a subscribe link.

items.name: sign-in-01
items.title: Sign In 01
items.description: A passwordless sign in card that morphs from email to a six digit code to the signed in account, easing its height between steps, with a back button and a resend timer.

items.name: newsletter-01
items.title: Newsletter 01
items.description: An email signup beside a fanned stack of past issues; subscribing drops the next issue, addressed to the reader, onto the stack.

items.name: comparison-01
items.title: Comparison 01
items.description: An us versus them table with a highlighted column, a sticky header and tick, cross and partial cells, stacking into cards when narrow.

items.name: contact-01
items.title: Contact 01
items.description: A validated contact form that morphs into a confirmation, support channel cards and office cards with a ticking local time.

items.name: blog-01
items.title: Blog 01
items.description: A blog index with a featured post, category chips, post cards, pagination and a reader that slides in from the side.

items.name: page-header-01
items.title: Page Header 01
items.description: A project header with breadcrumbs, meta, a star button and actions that folds into a sticky tab bar on scroll, with counts that roll.

items.name: notifications-01
items.title: Notifications 01
items.description: A notifications section with filters, a list grouped by day with read state, mark all read and details that open in place.

items.name: command-palette-01
items.title: Command Palette 01
items.description: A ⌘K command palette with search, grouped results, recent items, nested pages and shortcuts drawn as key caps.

items.name: file-upload-01
items.title: File Upload 01
items.description: A complete upload flow: a dropzone, per file progress, type and size errors, retry and remove, and a total progress bar.
